aspects.text:
A Sun-Moon conjunction generally indicates a sensitive disposition and a strong vitality. The combined energies can give rise to impulsiveness and a lack of patience towards others, particularly if they lack your high energy drive. This conjunction indicates a new moon cycle, depicting a desire to initiate new experiences reflected by the house in which these planets fall.

As the Sun and the Moon are significant elements of light, there will also be an emphasis of the zodiac sign traits in which these planets reside. In other words, the energy effects are enhanced. If too much contrast exists between your feelings and sense of being (or will), problems can arise with your physical vitality due to either excessive activity or lack of vigor. Providing your emotional intensity is not too great, you can achieve a balance between the male and female parts of your psyche.

This favorable aspect enables you to overcome many of the reactions that your conscious mind may form--as portrayed by the zodiac signs in which the Sun and Moon reside. It allows for the development of harmonious relationships with others, especially those of the opposite sex. This aspect generally infers that you are well able to nurture and care for children. You should be quite capable of generating warmth throughout your family home.

Health and vitality are stable, due to the emotional and physical balance inferred by this aspect. Your independence and self-reliance allow you to develop a number of creative talents. Such overall satisfaction may limit your view to the present rather than consideration of the future.

Although this is a challenging aspect, the key here is to develop the positive traits of both the zodiacal Sun and Moon signs. Without such development, or balance, you may sense a conflict between your conscious and unconscious desires. This may be reflected in emotional insecurity or a lack of certain expressions, particularly with those of the opposite sex. Relationships may prove difficult unless you are able to be consistent with your feelings.

Discord and emotional upheavals with certain family members may be prominent for some individuals, most likely because your parents manipulated you. By seeking ways to harmonize your vitality and emotions, your personal life will be greatly enhanced. Yoga and/or Tai Chi would be very helpful here. Becoming less defensive and more able to compromise may take some effort, and it could cause a few headaches along the way. However, the long term result is certainly worth it!

This favorable aspect enables you to develop a mature personality, which you express creatively. Because this maturity is combined with strong physical vitality, you show resilience with abundant regenerative power. This harmonious aspect enables you to nurture and care for children; warmth permeates within the family home. However, with certain harmonious aspects, there is a danger of becoming apathetic or even lazy--watch for signs of this!

There should be a definite balance between the male and female sides of your personality. Your inner balance allows for the development of harmonious relationships with others, especially those of the opposite sex. Without any significant challenging aspects elsewhere, you should be able to maintain comfortable surroundings. Health and vitality are stable due to the emotional and physical balance inferred by this aspect. Your independence and self-reliance allow you to develop several creative talents. This is often appreciated by those with whom you come in contact. Such overall satisfaction may limit your view to the present rather than consideration of the future.

Any disharmony that you experience, due to feelings not being in accord with your sense of will, should drive you to attain a balance between your egotistical senses and emotional feelings. The resultant humility, logical reasoning, and warm feelings will provide for significant soul growth. For some individuals, the disharmony may be reinforced as a result of a strain during childhood with one or both parents.

The Sun in direct opposition to the Moon simply means that you were born during a full moon. A full moon creates an atmosphere charged with changing energies. Therefore, there is often a clash between one's desires and sense of obligation--which makes decision making a dilemma for you. Personality conflicts (domestic, sexual, financial) can arise due to either the emotional nature of the Moon or the logical will of the Sun gaining influence. Bringing these two opposing reactions into harmony can be achieved by developing the positive traits of both the zodiacal Sun and Moon signs.

A full Moon can exert a strong influence on your vitality. It is therefore important to take steps to cure any restlessness and anxiety. Any imbalance will cause energy reserves to fluctuate considerably. Meditation, yoga and t'ai chi practices enable you to energize the body effectively, often circumventing health problems that can result in loss of physical vitality. Such techniques also free you from events of the past, enabling you greater expression by removing obstacles that block your path in life.

A Sun-Mercury conjunction channels physical energy into the conscious mind, enabling intelligence and a quick wit. This form of energy combination can reveal itself as high-strung, self centered, and even arrogant characteristics. Often, the ego side of the Sun's energy is dominant, providing will power and courage. On the other hand, this ego can inhibit self analysis. The house and sign in which the Sun resides can denote specific areas of activity associated with the mind and body.

You should take care when expressing or emphasizing your authority. Others may see you as threatening, though you may not want to admit it. This energized mind tends to tune out what others have to say while you think about what you want to say. In general, you like to show a relaxed yet confident personality. You often live by your wits and like to exchange ideas. Your creative abilities enable you to attain a top-ranking position. However, you consider job performance to be more important than the type of occupation. If solar energy is high, humility and compromise will allow for wonderful opportunities.

The power of this conjunction generates significant appreciation of literature, art, music, and beauty. There is an optimistic quality conferred by this aspect, and this along with friendliness and grace allows you to make friends very easily. The focus of your creative self-expression will generally be found in the house and sign that these planets reside. Females with this conjunction are generally very fertile and might therefore need to seriously consider contraception if children are to be planned.

Overall, your physical senses are strong and powerful, providing a love of life. Due to your strong ability to radiate love, you make others feel comfortable. This includes children, who should be well cared for by you. You are merry, sociable, and quite romantic. People perceive you as a good listener and thus enjoy your company. Since you do not want to be overlooked, you know how to leave a good impression. At times a little more modesty would be advisable.

This powerful aspect signifies an energetic expression that shows boldness, strength, and an ability to initiate action. With the desire of Mars channeled through the physical energy of the Sun, not only is there excellent vitality, but a tendency towards self-interest. The extrovert will be drawn to leadership positions and may possess an executive ability. Sometimes, actions are impulsive. Overall, humility and compromise will allow for significant opportunities for you.

Depending on the sign and house in which these planets reside, there is often a masculine quality conferred by this aspect denoting virility, even lustiness. Often, this aspect means that you are courageous and able to speak your mind; tough mindedness is common. If there is a tendency to take on too much, the psycho-physical system can be overloaded giving rise to inflammations, fevers, etc.

This aspect denotes courage and energy, with a healthy enterprising spirit. These characteristics are reflected in your ability to initiate new projects where you show good leadership qualities. You are able to foster cooperation and communication between friends, allies, and groups. By using your will (Sun), you can control your desires (Mars). You are decisive in realizing your goals and are not afraid to put your energy on display. There will be increased creativity as reflected by the sign and house in which each planet is located.

Physical exercise is important for you to release excess physical energy. However, be careful not to engage too energetically in areas where you may overreach yourself. This is because you can endure more pain than most. You are very capable of learning patience and humility in order to deal with life's contrasts.

Although this can be a very challenging aspect, the key here is to develop your prolific energy constructively. This is because your impulsive actions can lead you into areas of significant difficulty. Your reactiveness to obstacles is often revealed through frustration and aggression. An effective release may be found in the mind and body exercise of martial arts training. Without concerted development, you may experience isolation or bitterness between other people.

When provoked, your devilish side surfaces, and others may react with shock because they find your behavior irrational and egotistic. Try to avoid becoming part of a conflict situation; stand back and consider where your action may lead. If by controlling your anger and aggression you are able to proceed with tact and diplomacy, you can reach many goals in life. You should avoid becoming too compulsive in areas that ultimately create conflict. Gambling or obsessiveness in relationships invariably creates too much inner distress. If you do not refocus your energy, you may be affected by minor accidents and find your health impaired. Perhaps a good scream in the Grand Canyon will help!

This is a beneficial aspect that allows for basic desires to harmonize with one's sense of being. Therefore, your self-expression is energetically portrayed. This reflects in strong leadership qualities, courage, will power, and a determined approach to life. In addition, keywords such as ambition and self-confidence are often prominent, because the Sun and Mars are both rulers of zodiacal fire signs (Leo and Aries). The positive effect of this Solar-Martian combination is generally reflected in a fulfillment of one's potential, using creative and inspirational energy constructively. With sufficient optimism, your accomplishments will be noticed.

You might have considerable physical strength and determination, with an ample energy reservoir. This is often expressed with a self-centered focus toward achievement in a particular sport or activity. The solar energies depicting fairness, honesty, and integrity are also strengthened. Difficult tasks are viewed as an enjoyable challenge, since you enjoy creative solutions and are not afraid of applying yourself. This enthusiasm permeates into many areas, sometimes leaving a mark of distinction on your work. With this aspect, theory and practice go hand in hand.

If you have aggressive tendencies, try to establish a constructive channel to release your frustrations, rather than impulsively reacting to other people. Any disharmony that you experience, due to your desires not being in accord with your sense of will, should drive you to achieve balance between these senses. The resultant humility and sense of responsible anger, will provide for significant soul growth.

The ego and conscious desire may be in discord with this aspect, and it is therefore important that you come to terms with this conflict. Rivalry, strife, jealousy, and animosity are also indicated by this aspect. As the opposition aspect implies an overdoing of things, it may not be easy to come to terms with its influence. Are you inclined to have a contrary nature in which you end up quarreling about anything and everything? The greater aggression is expressed, the more likely that violence is manifested. As like attracts like, you attract others who are similarly aggressive--just like a moth to the flame. The pursuit of power aligns you with those who have similar tendencies, creating a strong clash of individual wills.

Become aware of the way your impulsiveness affects your surroundings. By developing your intuition, you can gain greater control, particularly in the area of sex, which may involve too much aggression. Depending on the house axis of these planets, much of your energy will be directed into the affairs of these houses. It is important that such effort is applied with as much dignity, diplomacy, and grace as is possible. Try not to assume just an "or" attitude, but consider "and" as well as "and/or" in your perception.

This powerful aspect signifies strength and expansion, which manifest both inwardly and outwardly. You are able to understand how to achieve your goals and how to expand your social position. Assistance is provided in the form of a cultured mind that is optimistic and generous. This in turn opens opportunities, particularly in the area of life reflected by the house in which these planets reside. Your enthusiasm and your interest in the well-being of others bring you success in gaining the support and cooperation of others for your goals. With this kind of outlook, there may be some dislike for those who are overbearing and judgmental in their ways. You are probably careful in choosing the right surroundings and seek one with which you can feel naturally contented.

Jupiter's expression of philosophy, law, and travel--in combination with the solar expression of strength and vitality--often yields an affiliation with or understanding of manmade or natural laws. A part of this knowledge is connected with wanting to know who and what you are. The experience gained through travel and meeting others further strengthens this expression. There is often a strong desire to live a fulfilled life, rich in experience and one that offers you enough possibilities to develop your creative expression. With such experience, you may find yourself in some kind of teaching role, but the overall focus in life will be determined by the house and sign in which this conjunction falls. Overall, with the abundance of opportunities presented in life, there is a feeling that "good luck" is to be expected.

You are generous, optimistic, warmhearted, and idealistic. It seems as if a personal guardian angel is your constant companion, since you seldom experience serious difficulties. Should you encounter problems, you always find a solution, because you have an intuitive knowledge of how to overcome obstacles in a constructive way. You have an innate skill in answering moral and ethical questions, since you are interested in the realization of spiritual and philosophical principles. With your self-confident and optimistic approach, you rarely lose sight of your goals. Therefore, you should be in a position to reach whatever you have set your heart upon. This attracts benefits to yourself and others.

Your benevolent nature wants to help those who are less fortunate than yourself. As a parent, you are kind, understanding, and responsible towards family members. With all of your well educated and spiritual understanding, you should succeed in leading a pleasant and tranquil existence, preferring a simple and frugal way of life rather than excessive opulence. There is often an urge to travel to far away places because of a great interest in foreign people and cultures. This allows you to expand your philosophy and understand yourself more.

Whether through erratic or foolhardy self-expression, the challenge here is to learn not to over-express your ego. There is often an inclination to want to do too much, too fast, without having the necessary dispensation to see things through. The self-perception that emerges becomes far-fetched and pretentious. This leads to rejection by others and some frustration on your part. The corresponding inability to reveal yourself truly to others results in further suffering. You may find yourself becoming critical of these people.

You should learn to exercise patience and self awareness. By applying techniques gained through positive experiences, and acquiring some self-discipline, you will be able to create the basis for significant self-development. The cost of this struggle in time and toil may be high, but it will ultimately provide success. The road to self-improvement is often fraught with self-doubt and self-criticism. Be aware of the true underlying motive for your actions. Often, the desire to travel or move to a new area may not be beneficial. Try to focus on your growth with discipline.

The energetic, fiery, and optimistic nature of this aspect often expresses itself well in ethical, philosophical, legal, and societal affairs. Your altruistic character generally wins the hearts and minds of others, possibly bringing you fortune and success. You may feel spiritually protected, and an innate sense of security radiates self-confidence and contentment. However, you do not like to capitulate and work hard with great courage to overcome any obstacle in life.

You are sinCeres and honest, which is reflected in a moral and ethical code of conduct in your business activities. Intuitive perceptions can assist you greatly in forecasting future developments. You can be counted on to help others generously. Although you love to travel, you may be attracted to tranquil places that offer solitude and contemplation. This tends to be significant for those with a hectic or public lifestyle. Be aware that this benefic aspect can cause apathy at times when events run too smoothly. During such times, make the occasional demand on yourself.

Any disharmony that you experience due to excessive reliance on luck (needing something for nothing) should drive you to attain a balance between your ego and sense of acquisition. The resultant humility, self-esteem, compassion, and generosity will provide for significant soul growth. Without such growth, you could be rather conceited and envious of others.

This indicates you need to be aware that you may behave too arrogantly or brashly with others. You may find yourself being very extravagant one moment and then over-compensating by being somewhat miserly the next. An innate feeling of being important compels you to make more promises than you can keep. Because of this, you run the risk of ruining your reputation. At times you may annoy others by trying to convert them to your own ethically moral view of life. You may even make totally unreasonable and unrealistic demands on others. You should consider developing a practical and realistic outlook to curb your tendency for arrogance and boasting.

Your striving for acceptance and success would be well served by making an effort to understand yourself better and acquiring some patience. The inclination towards being cavalier and being involved with impractical schemes does not bring respect. By recognizing people's needs and limits, as well as your own, everyone can focus on tasks more effectively. This may lead to creative teamwork in which you will be well cared for. Keep in contact with people who have supported you during your development, and show thanks for their assistance. You are then able to count on their further support.

Saturn generally represents restriction or consolidation. Any restriction hindering your personal expression and ambition indicates how you need to control your destiny through understanding human nature, priorities, and work structure. Often, this conjunction induces shyness, self-restraint, and high principles. Everything that you achieve costs you dearly in terms of effort. You are no stranger to hard work and may appear somewhat stoic to others. This is because you may find it difficult to express your enthusiasm or emotions.

As Saturn also represents the principle of perfection and accomplishment, be careful not to let perfection equal frustration. By gaining appropriate confidence and focus, you can use your organizational talents to exert a significant influence. Your relationship with your parents, particularly with your father figure, commonly plays a significant role. The severity of a father's discipline may have led to an unhappy childhood. This stern attitude will be reflected within you, unless you allow the Sun's vibrant energy to overpower Saturn's influence.

This sextile generally provides patience and self-discipline. You are able to develop practical and methodical characteristics, which will help in overcoming shyness. You have organizational talents and a head for business matters. You work hard to carry out ambitious plans in which you are realistic, honest, and sincere. You are often anxious about being informed regarding new developments. As such, you may be drawn into politics, since you have the desire as well as the ability to take on such responsibilities.

Your caution and prudence should provide good health, and you should be able to save your hard-earned salary since you earned it honestly. Although you sometimes appear reserved, you may also have satisfying friendships. You get along well with those who share your interest and your partner will probably also share your value of tradition and order. Together, the plans you make for the future can be realized through your own personal effort.

Although Saturn represents a challenge in terms of self-perception or insecurity when square to the Sun, these effects can be dealt with or consolidated through growth. With this aspect, it is often as if self-expression is inhibited, or awkward, and life offers too many obstacles. Such obstacles are usually more common in youth, but life can become easier when self-discipline is appropriately applied. By understanding human nature, priorities, and work structures, you will be able to gain greater control of your destiny. The alternative is to perpetuate an inefficient lifestyle, self-judgment, and judgment of others. You are inhibited yet want perfection and have high expectations of others, particularly those in authority. This often results in frustration, pessimism, low self-esteem, and internal stress. You must try to understand, at a deeper level, the expression "first sow what you wish to reap." You may long for certain changes in relationships or situations. If you feel that the physical world is a dark dreary place, this may cause loneliness. Perhaps in another life you imposed on others the kinds of experiences that you now have.

The severity of this aspect is significantly influenced by other planetary aspects to this square and the houses in which they reside. For example, if Jupiter favorably aspects this, the effect is lessened. If Saturn is in the first house close to the Ascendant, the potential for growth is significant! A typical effect of this influence can create some suffering with a father figure, lovers, children, and/or one's career. Such experiences will tend to impose restrictions and force you to learn some very hard lessons in those areas of life (houses) in which the Sun and Saturn are located in your natal horoscope. Generating self-esteem, loving assertion, and learning from harsh experiences, will enable you to obtain success through consolidated endeavors. Ultimately, you have the potential to be able to radiate optimism and cheer.

This trine indicates a natural aptitude toward accepting responsibility. With any Sun-Saturn aspect, there is a struggle for success, but because you readily accept responsibility, and have a flair for organization and focus, you will ultimately excel in your chosen field. Though you may not be lucky in the true sense of the word, you still manage to do the right thing at the right time intuitively. Thus it is unlikely that you will ever have to suffer from need, even in difficult times, because your realistic need for security has always made sure that you have put something aside for emergencies. This need has taught you to be patient and to avoid risks.

You probably view life in a genuine, practical, organized, and circumspect manner. In a methodical, yet self-sacrificing way, you devote yourself to the realization of useful and practical goals. You are very disciplined in your ability to concentrate and assess the effort required of any objective. With all of this focus, you may resist accepting direction from others as you like to feel that you are "your own person."

The disharmony that you experience from this could be due to excessive judgment, and wanting perfection from yourself and others. The resultant discord should drive you to attain a balance between your egotistical senses and common understanding. Attaining humility, self-esteem, patience, and a constructive outlook will provide for significant soul growth. Try to avoid any self-pity for hardships you must endure. For some individuals, the disharmony may be reinforced as a result of some strain with a father figure.

You may encounter circumstances that restrict or hinder your potential for effective self expression. This means that others may view you as seemingly unapproachable, puritanical, pessimistic, or cold. This may be due to a self-centered ambitious interest or focus. Are you somewhat snobbish? Your formal and special reserve can often lead to communication difficulties with both friends and lovers. Perhaps you are burdened by obligations to friends, partners, or relatives, which may affect your self-confidence.

Your self-expression may also be hindered by others' negative attitudes toward you. To realize part of your ambitions, you must work intensely and overcome most obstacles. The greatest hindrance to your success is your inability to love yourself. Possibly your parents were too strict or a burden to you. You should make space for self-development as and when you need it. Do not wait for others to put everything in your hands, since this could mean a long wait. In the meantime, you should develop a sense of humor and an optimistic outlook on life. Although at some stage you consider it vital to find out who you really are, try to be aware that it is the ability to compromise with others that can create success. Try not to overdo things too much. Self-judgment and a judgmental attitude towards others can indicate low self esteem.

Your sense of self (Sun) urges you to explore new areas of experience (Uranus). This often results in an interest with any form of research such as science or nature--anything where new discoveries or natural exploits are concerned. You find it easy to engage your willpower to fathom further depths in your chosen field. Having an extremely sensitive and highly intuitive nature, you are able to understand and perceive occult matters, particularly if you are in a position to experience such things. You are capable of coming to terms with most esoteric events because you approach many things in original and unusual ways.

Your actions can be powerful, abrupt, decisive, and seemingly rebellious. Those who do not understand your objectives may find you eccentric and dangerous. You like to be with others who look as expectantly to the future as you do. In your partnerships you should be careful to restrain your hasty temperament when dealing with your partner or you may damage the relationship. If you do not curb your temper there is a danger that you will lose your grasp of reality along with social contacts that would otherwise enrich your life.

This sextile should provide you with intuition, originality, and appropriate independence. Thanks to your open-mindedness and willpower, you can succeed where others fail. A special magnetic aura surrounds you which triggers a feeling of trust and enthusiasm from others. You know how to state your views and ideas without expecting others to accept them immediately and unconditionally. There may be an urge to awaken a deeper sense of yourself. You may want to express this outwardly by being drawn to a profession or activity concerned with improving the situation of others. Intelligence can be emphasized if you delight in activities that broaden your horizon.

With continuous development, your finely developed intuition enables you to effectively assess situations correctly and instantly form an opinion on them. An interest in the occult will enable a deep understanding, especially with areas such as astrology. If your focus in life is misdirected, there can be an inclination toward eccentricity. Your lively spirit and vitality may also be relevant in matters of the heart. As a liberal-minded individual, you show understanding for minor human weaknesses. However, do not allow your partner to treat you with disrespect, since this might create a lot of conflict within you.

The energies of this square tend to initiate a frisky and uncontrollable behavior. You may even attribute such moody behavior and eccentricity to certain things like the weather. Due to an inherent need to overestimate your importance and ideas, often done to shock people out of their archaic mode, you present yourself in a rather dramatic or startling manner. The consequential rejection causes you deep distress. This will not improve until you learn to weigh your audience, listen to what others have to say, and view such opinions in an objective manner.

The strange thing is that you can be quite original, but your approach rarely gains acceptance. Many ideas however are simply not feasible, since you may lack the necessary stamina and discipline to really see them through. Your work methods tend to be characterized by your somewhat volcanic and impulsive temperament rather than by any degree of continuity. Your originality and tendency for self-dramatization, together with an aversion to any kind of routine, could prove uncomfortable. Should you react too nervously at critical times, you may destroy the rational behavior you previously built with so much effort. Your pride and the desire for freedom at any price makes it difficult for you to listen to advice given by those around you.

The arrogance and the stubbornness with which you resist becoming a prisoner of routine may not affect your overall development adversely. Sudden changes in your life are often instituted for ultimate growth. You should exercise a degree of modesty and be sure to take one step at a time. You will get recognition from others only if they do not perceive you as a threat. Such recognition will be aided by listening and raising your own self esteem. Although you seem very capable, without self development and curbing your impulsiveness, you will probably be plagued with self doubt.

The energies of this trine project a highly intuitive and original mind. Your independent nature initiates unorthodox ideas that are quite original. Because you are able to attune yourself to vibrations beyond this dimension, you have a spiritual insight and creative talent. People with this aspect may also have unusual healing abilities, which if developed, could help others. With this trine you have an attractive, larger-than-life personality. Whenever the trine is activated by certain transits, you may have intuitive flashes of genius.

You prefer to devote yourself to scientific and esoteric studies. Your sense of will embraces new experiences and through experimentation, you can discover much that is new. Due to your humanitarian view of life, you are able to reform your surroundings. There is often a perception that the unity of all living things is only possible with a complete brother and sisterhood of humanity. You are attractive to your peers because you frequently show more interest for others than for yourself. You may be the inspiration they need, and you are probably in a position to give them a new zest for life, even if they do not realize it. You simply do not find the problems of other people trivial.

The disharmony that you experience from this aspect could be due to excessive willfulness and erratic behavior. The resultant discord should drive you to attain a balance between your egotistical senses and a need for independence and leadership. Attaining humility, receptivity, and common understanding will provide for significant soul growth. Without such growth, your impulsive actions may hurt others.

The opposition effects of these two planets tend to initiate frisky and uncontrollable behavior. There is an uncontrollable desire for unique independence, primarily because you are easily bored and need new areas of excitement. This, together with an overestimated sense of self-importance, easily generates opposition from those around you. You then perceive others acting in a dreary, archaic manner, so you love to shock them into new ways of living. It is no wonder then, that it is hard for you to get along with friends and partners.

When your views change, you do it totally unexpectedly and not always for rational reasons. Because of this, there may be some nervous tension that makes you easily excited. As a result, people may feel uncomfortable in your presence. Sometimes you purposely act in an overly conventional manner, merely to avoid an uproar in your surroundings. During such times, you cannot resist subsequently displaying your eccentric opinions, which corresponds to your present and actual standpoint. Therefore, it may be difficult to be in your company because of the way in which you are erratically perceived.

However, you may have the perception of being extraordinarily talented. Although it could be true, you do not always make wise and efficient use of your available talents. People with this placement may over-estimate themselves, so to speak. Exercise a little modesty and be careful that your inconstancy and impatience do not hinder you from being satisfied with your efforts. It is then that you can build the necessary foundation and experience to express your ideas. Planetary oppositions are normally equated with an over-doing of things or bringing people into your life that reflect your circumstance. In this case, it is characterized by the bohemian energies of Uranus and the ego (or sense of self) of the Sun. If you are able to grow as a person, sudden and shocking changes (related to transits during your life), that act as indirect wake up calls from other areas of the universe, occur less often.

The effects of this conjunction can, at certain times, create a form of separation from the physical world to that of living in a world of fantasy that only you seem to understand. You are subject to needs and feelings that stem from a subtle and sublime source, which may either send you into confusion and self-deception or bestow you on you a form of divine inspiration. Your sensitive energy potential is best expressed by the ability to portray such emotion with the full intensity of the depths of your consciousness. Sometimes you express this perceptive ability in artistic ways. A strong Neptune often enhances empathy, reflecting a kind and gentle personality.

It is important for you to develop your gifts in order to differentiate reality from non-reality--to understand what manages and controls your mental impressions. This is because it may be difficult for you to perceive the difference between true inspiration and the deceptive projection of your own unconscious desires. Neptune sometimes releases strange wishes and desires, or illusions, which can result in a certain ambition or a want of meaning in your life when conjunct with the Sun. In any case, you must face the realities of life, though your great sensitivity may cause you to suffer from it. In negative circumstances, you could fall victim to your own imagination and be deceived by it. In the worst case scenario, you may totally lose contact with reality. The sooner you abandon your unrealistic expectations, the sooner your suffering from disappointments will cease.

This sextile endows you with creativity and inspiration that can express itself in art and through your ethical attitude. Spiritual gifts of clairvoyance should be developed; without this development, visions received may not be easily conceived of or understood. You should delve a little into the areas of writing, fine arts, or music because you possess more than enough creative energy to excel in these arts brilliantly.

You sense that you could lessen much of the suffering in your surroundings. You may leave that task to others who seem to have more energy and focus to do so. However, that does not mean that your sympathy for the joys and sufferings of others does not show. You like to leave the impression of a humanitarian who has mystical insights. There will be some areas where you will need strength of purpose to actualize activities associated with your inspirational abilities. You are quite likely a good sleeper!

This aspect simply represents the concept of self-deception. If you like to revel in mysticism, you may see yourself as a chosen instrument of some guru or of some pseudo-divine being. This belief may stem from an unconscious wish for significance and recognition. The form of self-deception here may lead to manipulation and any lack of willpower will exacerbate this. You may feel strange emotional desires and romantic inclinations that include everything from platonic love to the most reduced form of sensuality. Secret love affairs could cause confusion. Perhaps your imagination is overexcited to such an extent that it leads you to intense desire and longing for an ideal which cannot possibly be met. The net result may produce nervous tension.

You may be inclined to work in a jerky manner. Such erratic behavior, together with your perception of reality, leaves a foggy impression on others. Nevertheless, if you let yourself be carried away into a fantasy world, you will never take responsibility for yourself and the concept of discipline may remain out of your reach. Therefore, try to get in touch with your inner conscience, in your own meaningful way, and request a clearer vision of physical realities.

This aspect should provide you with intuitive talent. Such intuition is of an emotional nature and is frequently expressed empathetically. Your intuitive talent may express itself in art or in music, and you are able to initiate spiritual awareness in others. Perhaps you have the gift of complete love that excels the personal, sexual, and physical forms of expression of this emotional condition. In its highest form, it can spiritually help and physically heal those you encounter along your path. Others may perceive you as altruistic, which you probably are. You appreciate elegance, grace, and high ideals.

You should develop a great deal of practical qualities. If not, it may be possible that you become a visionary, by which you are able to perceive certain business and market developments. You might be able to go with the flow of life in quite an effective way, even to the extent that you are at the right place at the right time to convey a special and impressive message.
